services.name: Rental Info
services.desc: Tickets for all live events are available here on our site. Just click on the TICKETS button next to the show you wish to attend and follow the prompts. Tickets are available in advance at The Animas City Theatre during business hours. There will be a ticketing fee applied to all online ticket purchasers and this fee will range from $2.50 - $4.00 based on the price of the ticket being purchased. In addition to this fee, there is a 3% credit card processing fee that is also included on top of the base amount of the ticket.
